done_so_far: fetchRobots implemented in src/discovery/robots.ts — fetches <origin>/robots.txt via fetchWithTimeout (10s AbortController), 200 -> robots-parser + captures raw content/sitemap declarations (resolved absolute via origin)/parseStatus ok|empty, 404/non-200 -> allow-all + statusCode + parseStatus 'unavailable', network/timeout error -> allow-all + statusCode null + parseStatus 'error'. isAllowed(url, ua?) delegates to robots-parser with default ua = the userAgent fetchRobots was called with; robots-parser's undefined verdict (host-mismatch ambiguity) is treated as allowed, not blocked. Never throws.

discoverSitemaps implemented in src/discovery/sitemap.ts — candidates = robots.sitemaps, else <origin>/sitemap.xml fallback; fetches + XMLValidator.validate() first (fast-xml-parser's XMLParser.parse() is lenient and does NOT throw on malformed XML, so validation must run before parse or malformed files parse into empty stubs silently); <urlset> -> entries with sourceSitemap; <sitemapindex> -> recurses (MAX_DEPTH=5, visited-set keyed by resolved URL so self-referencing/looping indexes terminate on first repeat); every fetched file recorded in files[] (kind urlset|index|unknown, urlCount, error) even on 404/network-error/malformed/gzip; entries deduped by URL keeping first sourceSitemap; MAX_ENTRIES=50000 safety cap; gzip sitemaps detected via .gz suffix, content-type, or 0x1f 0x8b magic bytes -> recorded as error 'gzip not supported in POC', never parsed.
